processing_steps.method: vacuum induction melting and casting into cylindrical copper moulds
processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Cylindrical copper moulds 32 mm in diameter by 186 mm in length; no further heat treatment reported for the as-cast state.

processing_steps.method: spark erosion cutting and surface grinding
processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Samples cut in the direction of the longitudinal axis of the ingot (casting direction); compression samples (6 × 6 × 10) mm^3; tensile flat samples (3.5 × 5) mm^2 cross-section with 15 mm gauge length.

structures.overall_structure: Two-phase Fe-Al matrix with MC carbide (VC) precipitates; the Fe-Al matrix is A2 bcc disordered for 15 at.% Al alloys.

interfaces.slip_behavior: Parabolic work hardening behaviour, typical for most disordered polycrystalline metallic materials

measurement_conditions.specimen_geometry: compression: (6 × 6 × 10) mm^3; tension: (3.5 × 5) mm^2 cross-section with 15 mm gauge length
measurement_conditions.other_conditions: Specimens cut along the longitudinal axis of the ingot (casting direction); surfaces ground; ZWICK 1474 universal testing machine.

tensile_properties.stress_strain_curves: Room-temperature compression curve (curve 3) shows parabolic work hardening; room-temperature tension curve rises almost linearly then falls nearly vertically (fracture with negligible uniform elongation, peak between 300 and 400 MPa gridlines).

comparative_performance.comparison_metric: Matrix Brinell hardness and yield stress in compression relative to binary Fe-15Al

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: Hitachi S-530, 20 kV, working distance 15 mm
characterization_methods.purpose: Investigation of fracture surfaces of tensile specimens
characterization_methods.key_findings: Coarse blocky transgranular cleavage with a smooth step-like facet for Fe-15Al-2V-1C (fracture mode TGC).

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: load 62.5 g, indentation ball 2.5 mm diameter
characterization_methods.key_findings: Matrix Brinell hardness of Fe-15Al-2V-1C is 191 HB.

characterization_methods.purpose: Determination of yield stress, total elongation and stress-strain curves
characterization_methods.key_findings: Fe-15Al-2V-1C: compression yield stress 396 MPa, tension yield stress 374 MPa, total elongation 0.6%.

unmapped_findings: Fe-15Al-2V-1C exhibits strengthening of the Fe-Al matrix compared to the binary Fe-15Al alloy, based on hardness and compression tests [b0021].

At room temperature, the Fe-15Al-2V-1C compression curve (curve 3) shows parabolic work hardening, while its tension curve fails with negligible uniform elongation between the 300 and 400 MPa gridlines [b0025][figure_002][figure_003].

In Fig. 5, the compressive yield stress of Fe-15Al-2V-1C lies slightly below the 400 MPa gridline at the lowest temperature, decreases monotonically with increasing temperature, and by 800 °C converges low between the 0 and 100 MPa gridlines (no numeric value labels printed) [b0038][figure_005].

At 650 °C and 800 °C, Fe-15Al-2V-1C shows tension-compression asymmetry (compression yield stress exceeds tension yield stress), consistent with all investigated alloys; no numeric value labels are printed in Figs 7 and 8 [b0040][figure_007][figure_008].
Fe-15Al-2V-1C fractured by coarse transgranular cleavage (TGC) at room temperature, corresponding to its brittle behaviour [b0031][b0035].
